Interactive DOM body/title readiness and three equal signatures without image-completion gating; generation/signature-rechecked isolated snapshot; manual verification, explicit retry, bounded deadlines and correlated callbacks. Live browser exports never refetch their HTML. Direct HTTP challenge detection hands off to the visible ephemeral browser. One retained export lease across direct/browser/verification/render paths; cancellation and typed failures. Per-image 4s/8MiB, 35s/48MiB total, 128 distinct cached assets and duplicate preservation; fresh monotonic invocation per asset. Ordered CoreText/image PDF, in-place missing marks and accurate counts/footer, reject image-only/no-decoded-content results. Stream to private temp, validate page/file bounds and publish protected final file only after success. Preserve original shared network/privacy/security kernels. iOS uses foreground UI and Files storage, not Android accessibility clipboard control, background foreground-service notifications or MediaStore. No native execution claim.
